sql:
WITH tg AS (
  SELECT games_game_id AS game_id, game_date_est AS gdate, home_team_id AS team_id, CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."src_games"
  WHERE season = 2012 AND games_game_id >= 21200000 AND games_game_id < 21300000
  UNION ALL
  SELECT games_game_id AS game_id, game_date_est AS gdate, visitor_team_id AS team_id, CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."src_games"
  WHERE season = 2012 AND games_game_id >= 21200000 AND games_game_id < 21300000
),
grp AS (
  SELECT team_id, game_id, gdate, win,
         SUM(1 - win) OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY gdate, game_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS loss_grp
  FROM tg
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT team_id, loss_grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_length, MIN(gdate) AS streak_start, MAX(gdate) AS streak_end
  FROM grp
  WHERE win = 1
  GROUP BY team_id, loss_grp
)
SELECT team_id, streak_length, streak_start, streak_end
FROM streaks
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY streak_length DESC) = 1
ORDER BY team_id
